rundown: Taylor Fritz beat Thiago Agustin Tirante in sets: 6-2, 4-6, 7-6.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 14, 6:57 AM ET. It had Taylor Fritz 76% and Thiago Agustin Tirante 24%.

Final: Taylor Fritz 2 – Thiago Agustin Tirante 1. Right winner: it had Taylor Fritz at 76%.

review.title: Against the market
review.body: Taylor Fritz to win: the algo gave it 76%, THE PICK — won.

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body: Flagged going in: there were no odds to check the projection against.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body: The result goes into both players' Elo ratings at the next data run, so their next match is priced on it.
